summary: Stop-guard fired at Phase 1 (as the prior planning handoff's next_action_hint predicted). The landed task-340 interface is weaker than the plan's Preconditions (2)+(3): task 340 delivered the carrier member (kvE2_sepHonestOrder_mem_arr', SW:2146), per-owner realizer bundles (kvE2_sepHonestAnchorBundleL/R, SW:2290/2329), tuple-index monotonicity (kvE2_sepHonest_cross_region, SW:2222), and the reduction kvE2_sepBody_complete_holds (SW:2267), but NOT the assembled boundary-linked regionsL/R, NOT the alignment fact halignL/R, and NOT the endpoint boundary alignment hbdry. Root cause is a carrier-granularity gap: the landed kvE2_sepSlotGIdx (SW:1006) reads kvE2_sepHonestTuple (SW:2095) = (3r,3r+1,3r+2), i.e. ONE global index per owner-REGION (with ties across all base slots of the same owner-region), not a value-faithful per-INDIVIDUAL-SLOT index. So kvE2_sepSlotsLOf (SW:1034, mergeSort by that index) is NOT value-sorted within tie-blocks, and the required halignL/R (mergeSort order = engine value-sorted interleaveK ps order) is unprovable whenever an owner-region holds >=2 base types. Per the stop-guard, 337 must NOT re-derive the carrier value-faithfulness inside 337. No Lean written; no declaration edited; SharedWitness.lean remains post-340 green.

blockers.root_cause: Landed kvE2_sepSlotGIdx (SW:1006-1013) reads kvE2_sepHonestTuple (SW:2095-2103) = (3r,3r+1,3r+2): one index per owner-REGION, not per individual slot. kvE2_sepSlotRank (SW:245-253) gives all .lXU slots rank 0 and all .lUW slots rank 2, so every base slot of one owner-region shares its global index (a tie). kvE2_sepSlotsLOf (SW:1034) mergeSorts by this tied index, so within a tie-block of >=2 base types the order is stable-input (enum) order, unrelated to realizer M-values. The bracket .holds (IntervalPattern.holds_eq_succ mpr, dual of kvE2_sepDisjunct_extract SW:2625) needs a strictly-monotone ws realizing each slot's charBase-chi type at its mergeSort position; the engine k1v_sorted_realizationK emits interleaveK ps value-sorted (ps.map fst a List.Perm of region types). These two orders cannot be reconciled (halign) against a tied per-owner-region index.
blockers.why_not_337_territory: Building halignL/R + regionsL/R + hbdry requires re-deriving the carrier value-faithfulness of the global index down to individual slots -- the exact re-scope the 3-agent synthesis rejected (report 04 Q2) and the plan's Non-Goals + Rollback bullet 3 + interface-stability note forbid. The 340 Phase 5D docstring (SW:2249-2260) reassigns regions assembly to 337, but the ingredients it points to (per-owner bundles relative to a single anchor + fixed endpoints) do not give fine-grained realizer placement across merged anchor gaps, and the tied index cannot be value-sorted per-slot.
blockers.prohibited: No sorry, no def X := True, no vacuous placeholder; do NOT re-derive carrier value-faithfulness inside 337; do NOT edit any 334/336/338/339/340 declaration.
